title: Chapter 1366
text:
Black Star's opinion was an important reference for the three Universal Civilizations when making decisions. It was as comfortable as reading a strategy and fighting monsters, allowing the upper echelons of the three Universal Civilizations to fully experience the joy of hugging someone's thigh.

However, he could not contact Black Star now, so he could only think of a way himself and act according to the situation.

Simon calmed himself down and slowly said, "Now, there are two solutions.

One is to locate the various camp bases, and the other is to use an efficient and low-energy method to break through the Lerbo Space Protection Belt and destroy the enemy's various artillery strongholds. "

"If Destiny's Child's surveillance does not yield any results, we can either passively wait for the various bases to launch over-the-horizon attacks and reverse analyze the source of the attacks, or wait for our control range to slowly cover it …"

A staff officer said.

Hearing this, the Ethereal commander shook his head and said,

"As long as the World Tree's over-the-horizon camps exist, they will definitely destroy our space anchoring orbits, surveillance base stations, and other facilities, preventing us from expanding our control range. In the areas that we do not cover, the World Tree can expand the scale of the camps at will. These resources are just a drop of water in the ocean to them. They can use extremely low costs to form a tug of war with us and obstruct our movements … So, from the looks of it, we can only wait for the other party to make a move before locking onto them. It's very passive. "

"How about using reconnaissance ships to conduct a large-scale search?"

"The area that we don't cover is too large. This method is like looking for a needle in a haystack. Furthermore, the other party will definitely place a large number of patrol fleets near the camp area. It won't work easily."

"What about mysticism?"

Secret Master interrupted. "The World Tree has targeted defenses in this regard, so we can't use mysticism to locate them."

Everyone discussed for a while but did not come up with an effective plan. They could only put aside the problem of locating them and discuss the attack method.

"Compared to locating them, destroying the base is not difficult." This time, the dynasty's commander said slowly, "We can use the Spacetime Splicing Technology to allow the small fleet to carry high-energy explosive bombs and directly pass through the Lerbo Space Protection Belt to blow up the other party's base."

"Spacetime Splicing Technology … is indeed feasible."

Simon pondered for a few seconds before nodding.

During the war mobilization phase, the three Universal Civilizations had communicated with each other and briefly introduced most of their trump cards to each other. This was why the upper echelons of Radiance and Ethereal all knew that the dynasty had the Spacetime Splicing Technology.

In terms of the method of attacking the camp, everyone had the same opinion. The spacetime splicing technology was extremely suitable for this kind of large-scale attack. Compared to sending the army to take the brunt of the enemy's firepower, this was obviously a method with lower consumption. The cost was at most a few hundred warships and a group of dispensable suicide squads. The main reason was to be safe and switch to manual control in case of an accident.

Everyone present had a good idea of who would be in the suicide squad.

"Let the Immortals of our army carry out the Spacetime Splicing Mission. This is a job that they love," Aurora said, blinking her eyes.

"Sure."

Simon had no objections. After pausing for a moment, he added, "It's best for the suicide squad to choose low-pollution bombs, and they have to be powerful enough. Otherwise, they won't even be able to blow up the shield of the base."

After deciding on the method of attack, the group returned to the topic of positioning. There had to be a result.

"It's not impossible to passively wait for the enemy to attack, but if we can't block the enemy's attacks, our losses will only increase. We need to find a way to protect the various branches of the Space Stabilization Anchor."

"With all due respect, it's almost impossible to protect the safety of all the orbital branches under the enemy's attack of an unknown scale and direction. After all, there are too many branches, and the number is still increasing. We don't have a defensive device like the Lerbo Space Protection Belt. At most, we can only try our best to clear the directional targets left behind by the enemy's small troops," an officer said helplessly.

"The enemy is in the dark while we are in the open. We can't deal with it for the time being. However, if we can seize and analyze the Lerbo Space Protection Belt, we can have the same defensive advantage as the enemy and reduce our passivity." Simon pondered and said, "Therefore, other than the Spacetime Splicing Suicide Squad attack, we still have to send official troops depending on the situation."

The Spacetime Splicing Squad could only die and could not obtain any spoils of war. They still had to rely on high-level combatants.

Currently, one of the few good news was that the targets of the World Tree's over-the-horizon attacks were limited. They either aimed at the directional targets left behind by the reconnaissance troops or the targets near the base. They could not accurately attack other locations. It was equivalent to every camp base being a trap. Only when the three Universal Civilizations' fleets attacked them would they be exposed, so they were not too worried about being attacked by over-the-horizon attacks on the way.

…

Kant's army quickly retreated, losing a lot of men. Most of the outer armor of the remaining battleships had traces of damage. They did not complete the mission and could not destroy the World Tree base.

The only gain was that when they were enduring the over-the-horizon attacks from other directions, the intelligent calculation model had analyzed the locations of a few new camps, increasing the targets of the three Universal Civilizations' attacks.

Not long after, the second batch of fleets set off, heading toward these bases separately. They were all equipped with the dynasty's improved Spacetime Splicing Device, which would only be activated when they arrived at their destination.

The crew members were basically army players who had been recruited temporarily. They did not have the tragic atmosphere of a hero who would never return. The atmosphere of every battleship was very relaxed, and a large number of players had happy expressions on their faces. They did not look like a group of death squads, but more like they were on an outing.

"I didn't expect the rewards for such a suicidal mission to be so generous. Luckily, I got it."

"It's too easy to complete the mission just by sending people to their deaths."

"How comfortable. If we can do it a few more times, wouldn't it be equivalent to farming EXP?"

Hearing the excited discussions of the players around him, Mad Blade was also very happy.

The players were the designated members of the suicide squad, and only the players could accept this mission. The mission briefly introduced the combat mission of the Spacetime Splicing Force. The players were shocked to find that this mission was actually not difficult for them at all, but the mission reward was so high that it was shocking. Even the credit of destroying the enemy base was given to them.

It was equivalent to not doing anything. As long as they went out and sent a wave of heads, they would be able to obtain EXP. It was extremely easy, just like farming EXP!

According to the forum, this combat mission was very important. It was actually very difficult and was equivalent to a suicide mission for normal soldiers. However, their innate advantages just happened to counter this difficulty, so they could obtain a high reward that did not seem to match the difficulty at all with a very small cost.

Not many players were willing to miss such a good opportunity. Due to the limited number of slots, many players almost fought over it. Only a few people obtained the chance to go out and were overjoyed.

Amidst the excited atmosphere of the players, the various fleets arrived at the different World Tree bases. Without a word, they activated the Spacetime Splicing Device and moved toward the base.

All sorts of over-the-horizon attacks came one after another, shattering the fleet. However, the next moment, the fleet returned to normal and continued to jump forward. Very soon, they broke into the Lerbo Space Protection Belt and were not affected.

When the Spacetime Splicing Force was halfway there, the World Tree base sensed through the space radar that this was an unknown spacetime technology. They quickly stopped their normal attacks and used spacetime methods to target it.

The Spacetime Splicing Technique was not unsolvable. Its nemesis was spacetime technology. Back then, the dynasty had also used the same method to crack this black technology from the Kunde Race. The World Tree base's response was very effective. The distance between each frame of the Spacetime Splicing Force began to shorten, and the flickering white noise on the surface became denser. The collapse speed increased.

However, after many years of improvement by the Red Empire, although the Spacetime Splicing Technique was still countered by space methods, its resistance had greatly increased, and it could last for a longer time. The Spacetime Splicing Force carrying the high-energy explosive bombs endured the World Tree base's targeting and stubbornly passed through the Lerbo Space Protection Belt, exploding in the base group.

Amidst the shocking fluctuations, dazzling energy balls lit up in the universe one after another, engulfing the entire base.

At the same time, in the temporary base of the Black Star Corps, white light flashed, and the army players who acted as the suicide squad revived in their bound stronghold.

Mad Blade opened the interface and looked at the mission that had become completed. He smiled like a chrysanthemum blooming.

"I'm rich, I'm rich. After eating this wave of rewards, my level should be able to surpass the players in the first tier … I wonder if this mission is a one-time thing. I really hope to do it a few more times."

…

Using the Spacetime Splicing Technique, the three Universal Civilizations could effectively attack the World Tree's over-the-horizon camps.

The World Tree did not have a good solution for this kind of black technology. It could only continue to carry out its original strategy and continuously destroy the anchoring orbit of the three Universal Civilizations. The three Universal Civilizations, on the other hand, kept sending people to destroy the exposed bases, and the two sides engaged in a tug of war.

Because the Spacetime Splicing Force was not afraid of conventional attacks, the World Tree reduced the over-the-horizon attacks against the incoming fleet. It did not want to expose the location of more bases for nothing. Making use of this, the three Universal Civilizations secretly sent out a wave of normal fleets led by high-level combatants to mix in with the Spacetime Splicing Force and successfully break through a base. They seized a set of Lerbo Space Protection Belt equipment and hurriedly transported it back to the main base for analysis.

In the huge frontline research institute, the Lerbo Space Protection Belt's generator was suspended in a vacuum bubble. A large number of mechanical probes were inserted into the structure of the device, constantly detecting the parameters and deducing the principles. Countless technicians were busy in front of different instruments.

Simon and the other senior officers were also paying attention to the analysis progress of the research institute. The remote projection stood on the ground and looked up at the Lerbo Space Protection Belt in the air. They were excited.

"Originally, it was just an attempt. I didn't expect to really seize this device. The expedition team was almost wiped out."

"If we can analyze this technology, not only will we be able to deal with the enemy's over-the-horizon attacks, our intercepting circle will also be more difficult to break through."

Just as the group was rejoicing, the lights of the research institute suddenly turned into a dazzling blood-red color, and a buzzing alarm sounded.

"Alert! Alert! Unknown data has been detected trying to sneak into the firewall … "

The technicians present trembled and quickly checked the source of the problem.

"What happened?" Simon's expression changed.

"Reporting, this device seized by the frontline seems to carry some kind of extremely latent data virus. It is invading the firewall on its own, trying to search for information from our database …" the research team leader hurriedly replied.

"Where's the hidden danger inspection report? Why didn't we find this virus beforehand?" Simon asked.

"This … all the tests were passed … It can only be explained that this unknown virus escaped our detection." The research team leader gritted his teeth.

At this moment, the frequency of the alarm increased again. Many technicians were sweating profusely as they shouted.

"The level-1 firewall has been breached! The level-2 firewall has been breached! "

"Too fast! The invasion speed of this virus is too fast! "

"Requesting immediate mobilization of the main artificial intelligence computing power to suppress it!"

Simon hurriedly leaned in front of the technician's screen to take a look. He saw that this unknown virus was like a hot knife through butter, breaking through layers of firewall shells and was about to officially enter the quantum network on the surface of the intercepting circle base group.

However, at this moment, silver streams of data suddenly appeared, instantly wrapping around this unknown virus. It was like white blood cells swallowing the virus. No matter how hard it tried, it could not escape the seal of the silver data, and its speed instantly slowed down.

A large amount of silver data streams appeared again, condensing into Manison's virtual figure with a calm expression.

"The Mecha Empire!" Simon's eyes lit up.

"I sense fluctuations in the network. Looks like there's a problem here … Is this the World Tree's virus?"

Manison reached out and grabbed this struggling unknown virus in his hand, carefully sizing it up.

Seeing this, Simon immediately asked, "How's the situation?"

"This thing is a virus-type artificial intelligence, not pure data."

Manison replied calmly.

At this moment, this unknown virus suddenly exploded and disappeared. The alarm of the research institute immediately stopped, and the lights returned to normal.

"You destroyed it?" Simon was stunned.

"No, it realized that it couldn't break through my seal, so it decomposed itself … If I'm not wrong, this artificial intelligence life is a member of the World Tree and can also enjoy the revival of the World Tree. It has an innate advantage in the quantum network, and most firewalls can't stop it."

Manison narrowed his eyes.

"I see …" Simon pondered for a few seconds before relaxing. "Fortunately, we have you this time. Otherwise, even if we could eliminate it, some information would have been leaked."

If the three Universal Civilizations mobilized more of their main artificial intelligence computing power, they could also eliminate this artificial intelligence life, but they were a step too slow. If not for Manison's high-speed reaction, the enemy's artificial intelligence virus might have invaded the quantum network and allowed the World Tree to know a portion of their information through information sharing.

Due to the disadvantage in intelligence, the World Tree had used more methods to gather information about the three Universal Civilizations. Naturally, information warfare was inevitable.

"Black Star isn't here. Leave this to me."

Manison replied calmly and deactivated the virtual figure.

Hearing this, Simon heaved a sigh of relief.

Although when the strongest Mechanic in the galaxy was mentioned, the first person everyone thought of was Black Star, causing the existence of the Mecha Empire to decrease.

However, he could not underestimate the Mecha Empire just because of Black Star's strength. After all, he was at the peak of the previous generation of Mechanics, and his standard was still there. Putting aside the conflict of ideals, Simon still believed in the Mecha Empire's ability.

…

Although they had temporarily lost Black Star's help, with the foundation that Han Xiao had laid, the three Universal Civilizations were still fighting the World Tree.

Both sides used all kinds of Universal Treasures and special technologies to restrain each other. For the time being, they could not do anything to each other.

The World Tree would occasionally send out some foreign experts that it had devoured to test the waters. Due to Black Star's existence, the World Tree had already turned the foreign experts into cannon fodder. Since they could not be of any use on the battlefield, they might as well use them to harass and exhaust them.

However, because Han Xiao had entered the Sanctum, the foreign experts of the World Tree did not receive the virtual purification treatment and could only be killed by the Beyond Grade As of the explored universe.

However, even without Black Star, the Beyond Grade As were still able to hold their own and did not cause any trouble.

The two sides fought back and forth while silently brewing. The intensity was maintained at a relatively low level.

This stalemate lasted for about two months before Han Xiao returned from the Sanctum.
